_: 게임 전체에서 고정하는 것. 캐릭터마다 바꾸는 것은 generate_asset.py 의 --prompt 로 준다.
GLOBAL_STYLE: polished 2D game art, 90s arcade video game aesthetic, stylized character design, bold clean shapes, strong readable silhouette, strong saturated colors, clear separation of body parts
CAMERA: full body, centered composition, symmetrical composition, isolated character
BACKGROUND: isolated on plain flat background, no scenery

ASSET_TYPE.character: full body 2D game character, facing forward, standing pose
ASSET_TYPE.enemy: full body 2D game enemy character, facing forward, standing pose, menacing
ASSET_TYPE.item: single 2D game item icon, centered, isolated
ASSET_TYPE.vehicle: single 2D game vehicle, side view, isolated
ASSET_TYPE.background: 2D game background layer, wide, no characters
ASSET_TYPE.ui: 2D game UI element, flat, clean edges

NEGATIVE: photorealistic, realistic photograph, 3d render, background, scenery, landscape, multiple characters, multiple objects, cropped, cut off, out of frame, extra arms, extra legs, extra fingers, deformed hands, bad anatomy, malformed body, duplicate limbs, duplicate body parts, blurry, low resolution, messy details, text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, signature
